sources.summary: Located on the quiet outskirts of Ahmedabad , Malhaar gathers itself inward, forming a single-storey world organized around a central court — a space that is less a void and more a living core. Here, the architecture does not simply enclose; it orbits. Daily life unfolds in slow circulation along the edges of this open centre, where movement, light, and air are constantly in dialogue.
